name: CrankWheel
summary: No-download screen sharing for sales calls — a prospect clicks a link and sees your screen on any device. Deliberately narrow: no video conferencing, webinars or collaboration.
best_for: sales reps, insurance agents and consultants who need prospects to view a screen instantly with no download or install, on any device
skip_if: you need full video conferencing, webinars or team collaboration (Zoom/Meet fit better), or your call volume stays under the free tier
honest_knock: It's deliberately narrow — instant, no-download screen sharing for sales calls — so it's excellent at that one job and thin everywhere else: no full video-conferencing suite, no deep collaboration or webinar tooling. Mind which plan caps what: the free plan drops to 15 sessions a month after the first fortnight and Team puts everyone on a shared pool of 100, while Solo is the one paid tier with unlimited usage. If you want an all-purpose meeting platform, this isn't it; if you want prospects to see your screen in seconds with zero friction, that focus is exactly why it works.

pricing.notes: (read on crankwheel.com/pricing, 2026-08-21) A free plan with no payment details required — unlimited usage for the first 15 days, then up to 15 sessions a month for life. Solo is $29/month for one user with unlimited usage, up to 30 viewers per share and up to 10 video-conferencing participants. Team starts at $99/month for unlimited users sharing 100 meetings a month, rising in steps: Team 200 $194, Team 500 $467, Team 1000 $882, Team 2000 $1,562. Busy User discount plans cost less for a capped number of users — Team 100 at $59 for three users, Team 500 at $287 for fifteen. Enterprise is quoted per year and the page prints no figure. A meeting counts at 40 seconds with a viewer, or when you create a share link or segment, or on an Instant Demo call.

free_plan_evidence: (read on crankwheel.com/pricing, 2026-08-21) A free plan with no payment details required — unlimited usage for the first 15 days, then up to 15 sessions a month for life.

compare_with.name: Zoom or Google Meet
compare_with.why: general meeting platforms — CrankWheel's edge is zero-friction, no-download instant sharing for live sales, not full conferencing
